purpose: Loud Crisp Overrun Pops Across Mid/High RPM & Decel Transition Validation

tune.status: Candidate prepared and verified in VCM Editor; ready for owner flash

changes_since_previous_run: Derived from paired v032 drive logs: (1) Deepens [ECM] 44605 3,000 RPM cell to -8.00 deg ATDC (was -3.00 deg) and 4,000-6,000 RPM to -10.00 deg ATDC (was -8.00 deg) for sharp, loud, acoustic crackles; (2) Lowers 2,000 RPM cell from +8.00 deg to +2.00 deg to prevent premature positive timing pull during coast-down; (3) Extends [ECM] 44496 DFCO delay from 1.35s to 1.40s (+50ms) to widen overrun fuel duration. Preserves v032 anti-shuffle fix (ECM 44771 Disabled, OSCMOD 1.000) and v031 MAF trim.

stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
